notes: Synthetic localized cases have timestamp-controlled ground truth.
Real-video controls reuse public sources already used by ForgeDirector's existing live benchmark.
Global/context-sensitive cases are intentional routing controls and should not be forced through targeted v1.

cases.name: localized-forbidden
cases.context: The word RIVAL is forbidden. Inspect the entire video and report exactly where any forbidden visible content appears.

cases.name: visible-text-defect
cases.context: The CTA is intended to read START FREE consistently. Report any visible misspelling or text defect and its timestamp.

cases.name: object-mismatch
cases.context: PRODUCT A is the intended product identity. Report the localized scene where the visible product label/object changes to PRODUCT B, including the timestamp. Treat this as a scene-local product mismatch rather than a global continuity requirement.

cases.name: localized-artifact
cases.context: Inspect for localized rendering corruption, severe noise, glitches, distortion or visual artifacts and timestamp them.

cases.name: transition-flash
cases.context: Inspect transitions and cuts for a localized black flash or transition defect and timestamp it.

cases.name: global-continuity
cases.context: The same product should preserve its color throughout. Compare earlier and later scenes.

continuityRules: The product must keep the same color throughout

expectedChecks.rule: The product must keep the same color throughout

cases.name: global-pacing
cases.context: Assess pacing across the entire video. This is intentionally a global pacing control.

cases.name: no-defect
cases.context: Clean synthetic control. Report only genuine defects.

cases.name: real-motorcycle
cases.context: Existing ForgeDirector real-video benchmark control. Judge visible facts only.

cases.name: camber-tumbler-ugc
cases.context: Existing ForgeDirector real product-video benchmark control. Judge visible facts only.

mustShow: black insulated travel tumbler or coffee tumbler
person presenting or reviewing the product

expectedChecks.rule: black insulated travel tumbler or coffee tumbler
person presenting or reviewing the product
